architecture_contract.data_types: All 19 architectural TileDataType values and mixed operand types use deterministic PTO-v0 raw-carrier hooks; target numeric interpretation remains S5-T2.
architecture_contract.layouts: Row-major and column-major operands may be mixed; implementation-defined layout rejects before effects.
architecture_contract.locations: Vector, Matrix, Memory, and Any locations have identical PTO-v0 logical semantics.
architecture_contract.source_definedness: Every matrix, vector, bias, and scale source must have a defined valid region; accumulate forms additionally require a defined destination.
architecture_contract.preflight: All descriptor, type, layout, shape, source-definedness, and accumulate checks precede the first destination effect.
architecture_contract.aliases: The representative destination-left, destination-right, source-source, destination-bias, destination-row-scale, destination-column-scale, extra-source, accumulate, ACCCVT, and TGEMV alias classes observe snapshotted pre-instruction source values.
